categories.main_business_segments: CNOOC Limited primarily operates in upstream oil and gas exploration, development, production, and sales. It also engages in oil and gas trading and corporate management activities. The company focuses on conventional oil and gas, shale oil and gas, oil sands, and other unconventional oil and gas businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced offshore oil and gas exploration and production technologies, including deepwater ultra-deepwater development, enhanced oil recovery techniques, and intelligent oilfield construction. It has developed proprietary technologies such as the 'Deep Sea One' ultra-deepwater gas field and the first cylindrical FPSO in Asia. The company also emphasizes digital transformation, AI integration, and green technologies like offshore wind power and CCS/CCUS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CNOOC serves primarily energy companies and industrial customers in China and internationally. Its key customers include China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC Group), China Petrochemical Corporation (Sinopec), and various private refineries in China. Overseas, it supplies natural gas and LNG to multiple clients in the Asia-Pacific region, including terminals in Guangdong and Fujian.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Chinese offshore regions including Bohai Bay, Western and Eastern South China Sea, East China Sea, and onshore China. Internationally, it has assets across Asia (Indonesia, Iraq, UAE), Africa (Nigeria, Uganda, Mozambique), North America (USA, Canada), South America (Brazil, Guyana, Argentina), Europe (UK, Russia), and Oceania (Australia).
categories.supply_chain_position: CNOOC operates primarily in the upstream segment of the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on exploration, development, production, and sales of crude oil and natural gas. It also engages in midstream activities such as LNG processing and trading but does not operate in downstream refining or retail.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes increasing reserves and production through exploration and value-driven acquisitions, with a strategic tilt towards natural gas and low-carbon development. It invests heavily in R&D for offshore exploration technologies, enhanced oil recovery, digital transformation, and green energy integration, including offshore wind and CCS/CCUS. R&D expenditure totaled approximately RMB 4.5 billion in 2024, with a focus on key core technologies and digital innovation.
categories.revenue_model: CNOOC generates revenue mainly from the sale of crude oil, natural gas, and LNG products. It also earns income from oil and gas trading activities and investment returns from subsidiaries and joint ventures. Revenue is primarily based on volume sales at market-linked prices, with long-term contracts for natural gas and LNG sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CNOOC is the largest offshore oil and gas producer in China and one of the world's largest independent oil and gas exploration and production companies. It competes with other major Chinese oil companies such as CNPC and Sinopec, as well as international oil majors in global markets. The company emphasizes its cost competitiveness, technological innovation, and diversified global asset base to maintain a leading industry position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, CNOOC reported total assets of approximately RMB 1.06 trillion and net confirmed reserves of 7.27 billion barrels of oil equivalent. The company achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 137.9 billion, representing an 11.4% increase year-over-year. Oil and gas production reached 726.8 million barrels of oil equivalent, growing 7.2% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong financial position with a capital debt ratio of 10.9%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CNOOC offers stable and reliable energy supply with a focus on offshore oil and gas resources, leveraging advanced exploration and production technologies. Its competitive advantages include a large and growing reserve base, cost-effective operations with a barrel-of-oil equivalent cost of $28.52, and a diversified global asset portfolio. The company integrates green and digital technologies to enhance sustainability and operational efficiency, positioning itself as a leader in both traditional and low-carbon energy sectors.
